slug: 2025-04-12 Cote d'Ivoire - Registre Social Unique (RSU) operationalisation, 200,000+ households

facts.fact: BCP Filets Sociaux says more than 200,000 households were in the process of registration in the RSU, managed through the SIG-RSU system, as of April 2025.

systems.owner: BCP Filets Sociaux (Ministère de la Cohésion Nationale)
